positive/.env.example:1:14  error  EG010 possible-secret-in-template  GITHUB_TOKEN in positive/.env.example looks like a GitHub personal access token
  variable: GITHUB_TOKEN
  evidence: detected: GitHub personal access token
  why: A template is shared with everyone who can read the repository; a real credential there is leaked, and it stays in git history even after it is removed.
  fix: Replace the value with an empty one or a placeholder (`GITHUB_TOKEN=` or `GITHUB_TOKEN=<your-value>`). If it is a real credential, rotate it now: it has been exposed. If it is a deliberate fake, use an obvious placeholder or add `# envguard-ignore EG010` on the line above.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG010-possible-secret-in-template.md
